items.quote: Ashavi led upholding governance and audit standards across the department.
Several respondents noted that Ashavi drove financial controls for the grant scheme for the whole division.
Direct reports said that Ashavi Korington headed service-level targets for frontline operations, setting priorities for several teams.
Peers observed that Ashavi Korington took ownership of presentations to senior management and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Ashavi drove the digital redesign of the permit system for the whole division.
Ashavi was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of bilateral negotiations on the water agreement.
Peers observed that Ashavi championed the transformation of the operating model and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Ashavi Korington championed capability building for new hires and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
